label: California deadline to submit a breach notice sample to the Attorney General
applies: A single sample copy of the notification, where a single breach requires notice to more than 500 California residents
note: This clock is measured from notifying affected consumers, not from discovery of the breach, so it runs from a different event than the 30-day deadline and can expire after it. The 500-resident trigger is the point at which an incident acquires a regulator audience as well as a consumer one.
author: Aaron Bollinger
